feeds.title: Mommy Travels
feeds.description: Explore the world with Meagan and her family as she shares travel tips, reviews of hotels and restaurants, activity suggestions, and itineraries. Whether on a budget and need to stay close to home, or able to have a luxury vacation somewhere far away, Mommy Travels will help you plan your vacation.

feeds.title: MummyTravels
feeds.description: Cathy is an award-winning travel-obsessed writer who's never knowingly underpacked. She is also mum to the mini traveller aka nine-year-old Minnie - and trying to work out how to cling on to normal life by her fingernails. From her experiences travelling in the UK and around the world, to reviews of the most useful paraphernalia, tips and advice, that's what she shares in this blog.

feeds.title: Journeys with Jenn
feeds.description: Jenn is a mom, writer, marketer, small business owner and social media influencer. She loves to travel- solo, with her family or with a group of friends. No matter where she is, she is always making an impact and sharing her journey.

feeds.title: A Mom Explores Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Emily. I'm a wife to Justin, a mom to 2 spunky girls and 2 energetic boys, a daughter of the King, and a lover of words. I want other moms to feel brave enough to head out into the world with their kids, no matter if they have infants, teenagers, or anything in between.

feeds.title: La Jolla Mom Blog
feeds.description: I'm Katie. I write La Jolla Mom. La Jolla Mom shares the best tips for San Diego vacation planning, luxury hotel perks, travel worldwide, theme park ticket discounts, & much more. I recap our trips and favorite places around the globe. I also talk about our favorite airlines, airport lounges, and gear. My information will help you plan and spend less on traveling.

feeds.title: Pattons with Passports
feeds.description: Explore reliable travel advice from Pattons with Passports, a family travel blog featuring travel guides for destinations in the US and abroad plus tips for traveling with young children. The Pattons is a family of four who is passionate about seeing the world, creating family memories, and sharing all of the research we put into our travels with you!

feeds.title: Mom and More » Travel
feeds.description: I am a 30-something-year-old stay-at-home mom with a 13-year-old boy, a 12-year-old boy, and a 9-year-old girl. I started blogging in August 2008. So here is my blog, still working on a niche but always blogging about something! If you are looking for traveling ideas, tips and advice for traveling with your children and family then take a look at my travel archive to read my own traveling experiences.

feeds.title: Mummy Matters » Travel
feeds.description: Mummy Matters is a lifestyle blog by a mother writing down her daily life. What can be more exciting than discovering new places and making memories to last a lifetime? There is a great wide world out there and so many wonderful sights to see. Sharing with you our travel hopes, dreams and memories.

feeds.title: The Super Mom Life » Travel
feeds.description: The Super Mom Life focuses on parenting related topics such as family friendly recipes, crafts, travel, pets and Super Mom's battle with anxiety.

feeds.title: Mix & Match Mama » Travel
feeds.description: A cookbook author, lifestyle blogger, travel agency owner, wife and mama who loves making every day special for my family. From holidays to regular days, I like to spend time with my girlfriends, watch Red Sox baseball, drink an insane amount of coffee, read my Bible and make a yummy dinner each night. I'm passionate about traveling, adoption and food.

feeds.title: Adventure Mom Blog » Travel
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Nedra McDaniel and I love sharing about adventures in Cincinnati and beyond. Read about our travel adventures in this section to help along your family travels with kids!

feeds.title: Travel Mad Mum
feeds.description: The Travel Mad Mum blog is filled with inspirational reads on travelling with young children. From newborn to kids and beyond.

feeds.title: Mom With Five » Travel
feeds.description: I'm Barbara - a woman, wife, mother, and blogger. Mom With Five blog was born to be a place where we can be our authentic selves as parents: not perfect, but the most outstanding in our goodness. A dash of cooking & creative work, a dash of travel & culture, and a big dash of family. Follow along.

feeds.title: Rich Mom Life » Travel
feeds.description: Rich Mom Life is a luxury mom blog about motherhood and lifestyle. In this section, find articles on travel.

feeds.title: City Chic Living » Traveling Mom
feeds.description: Alexandra Nicole is a traveling working mom who is always on the go. She enjoys toddler vacation destinations as well as inexpensive long weekend getaways.

feeds.title: Travel Mom Squad
feeds.description: Hi! We are Pam and Alex, a mother-daughter duo who love to travel! We have spent the last few years mastering how to travel for nearly free using credit card points. Now we want to share what we've learned so you can be off on your own adventures.

feeds.title: MadPsychMum
feeds.description: The Parenting and Travel Diary of a Research Psychologist and Mum of Two. This blog is all about art, motherhood, weaning, child development, psychology and all things motherhood.

feeds.title: Type A Travel Mom
feeds.description: I'm Amber. I'm the Type A Travel Mom. I love to travel, mostly in the United States, Mexico, and the Caribbean, but I wouldn't turn down any fabulous getaway. Happily married for over two decades with an only child, we like to hit the road (or the skies) any chance we get. Follow along my journey.

feeds.title: Traveling Foodie Mom
feeds.description: Welcome to the Traveling Foodie Mom blog! My name is Elissa. I'm a mom, wife, foodie, and travel enthusiast. I decided to start this blog to share with you some fun places to travel to with a highlight on the food scene in each location. I keep track of all my stops on my trips anyways, I might as well share these places with others!

feeds.title: Celeste Hedequist Blog
feeds.description: Celeste Hedequist, a mother of four, is a Boston native with a passion for traveling with her family. As a mom of four, Celeste Hedequist is a firm believer in teaching your children to live outside their comfort zone. Growing up in an affluent community, with a lack of diversity, has encouraged Celeste and her husband to travel with their children. Planning unique trips both domestically and internationally has become quite a passion for Celeste. Being able to put together an entirely different experience, filled with various adventures, is beyond rewarding for the whole family.

feeds.title: Slummy Single Mummy » Travel
feeds.description: I'm Jo - freelance writer and mum of two. I have yet to get the hang of the whole 'having a blogging niche' thing, so expect random musings on everything from my teenage pregnancy experiences to car air fresheners. This section features articles on my travel diaries.

feeds.title: Powered By Mom » Travel
feeds.description: I'm Michelle. I'm married with one daughter, my hubby was my high school sweetheart, our two dogs and our crazy but lovable cat. My family and I love to travel, try new foods and experience new cultures when we can. So our ideal adventure includes travelling to new places while trying local cuisines. Read about our escapades in detail in our blog!

feeds.title: The MOM Trotter » Travel
feeds.description: My name is Kay, and I am a mom, wife, aunt and the face behind The MOM Trotter. My goal is to inspire and encourage families to find a balance between parenting, educating their kids and traveling the world with kids. Traveling is such an adventure and even more when you travel with your kids. The Mom Trotter guides you on how you can enjoy travel with black kids.

feeds.title: No Back Home Blog
feeds.description: A travel obsessed mom and a nature obsessed son exploring at home in Southern California as well as throughout the world looking for adventure, nature, and a little luxury too!

feeds.title: Princess Turned Mom » Travel
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jenny Rose, welcome to Princess Turned Mom. I am a retired Princess providing encouragement for the 'happily ever after.' I am also a fire wife, mom of two with Disney in my veins and Jesus in my heart. Follow my travel blog to know about our family trips, advice for traveling without much hassle, our favorite travel destinations and more!

feeds.title: Girl Gone Travel Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Carol! I am a communications professional, an award-winning travel blogger, a public speaker, CEO of a social media marketing, communications, and branding agency, a wife, and a mom of 3 sons and 2 puppies. Welcome to my blog where I share stories of my travels and professional public relations insights and advice.

feeds.title: Following the Jordans » Travel
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Brittany. Small town mom of three and your new best 'virtual' mom friend. I am a NC-based motherhood and lifestyle blogger focused on letting you know that you are not alone. Here you will find all of my post related to our past travel or ideas and helpful tips about traveling. We love to adventure as a family.

feeds.title: Oneika the Traveller Blog
feeds.description: This is a travel and lifestyle blog penned by a Jamaican-Canadian who has been to nearly 100 countries. Toronto-born but New York City-based, she is obsessed with experiencing everything this gorgeous planet has to offer. This travel blog is dedicated to inspiring, encouraging, and empowering women and people of color to see the world.

feeds.title: SheBuysTravel
feeds.description: TravelingMom is the nation's top website and blog network dedicated to improving, enlivening and empowering the travel experience of moms everywhere. Get family vacation ideas, tips, tricks and hacks from the family vacation experts at TravelingMom. Learn what works for kids, what doesn't and what you need to know before you go.

feeds.title: The Travel Mom
feeds.description: I'm Emily Kaufman. My goal is to inspire, motivate, and encourage you to step out of your comfort zone to experience new things through travel. Catch me on the blog every week for travel news, destination insights, travel tips and vacation giveaways!

feeds.title: Mumpack Travel Blog
feeds.description: Mum and 11 year old daughter traveling the world. We believe travel can change the world, that its the best education for kids and for families to spend time together. We hope you can find the joy in travel that we have.
